notes.accuracy: Accuracy is invariant to temperature-only calibration: temperatures keep the argmax, and with a zero yes/no bias the P(yes) >= 0.5 threshold keeps its side. Both runs here have a zero bias.
notes.probabilities: Probabilities are as recorded: the old run with its released calibration, the new run with the calibration in its receipt (identity for the stage 1 candidate).
notes.state_chars: Characters of a string state, or of its canonical JSON when the state is structured.
notes.options: Yes/no questions count as two options; Score counts its levels.
notes.intervals: Paired new minus old accuracy with a percentile bootstrap 95% interval; 10,000 resamples for groups of 200 or more, 2,000 otherwise. Items within a state or group are not independent.
